title: omni settings
description: omni settings.json — manages all dev tools, dotfiles, host assignments, and groups from a single file.

$include.description: Additional settings fragments to merge into this file on load. Paths are relative to the directory containing this settings file. Stripped before save.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URI (injected automatically by omni on every write).

groups.description: Tool/dots groups. Host groups use special="host" and are reserved for one hostname.

host_settings.description: Per-host setting overrides keyed by short hostname.

hosts.description: Reusable group assignments keyed by short hostname. The matching special host group is active implicitly and must not be listed here.

ignore.description: Tool and dotfile names skipped globally.

tools.description: Logical tool specs keyed by logical tool name. Groups reference these keys by name.

version.description: settings.json format version. Missing means legacy unversioned config; omni migrates it to the current version on write.

AgentsConfig.description: Omni-managed AI-agent resources: skill packages, MCP servers, plugin marketplaces, and plugins.

marketplaces.description: Plugin marketplace sources for the configured agents.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server entries restored for the configured agents.

packages.description: Skill package sources restored by Omni.

plugins.description: Plugins installed from a declared marketplace or direct source.

skills.description: Legacy per-skill manifest. Accepted for one-time migration into packages and never written back.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server names skipped during restore/sync.

skills.description: Skill package sources skipped during restore/sync.

DotEntry.description: A dotfile or directory managed by 'omni dots'.

hosts.description: Host-specific stow package variants keyed by short hostname.

package.description: Stow package directory to use on this host.

ignore.description: gitignore-style patterns for files to skip within this entry.

ignored.description: Keep the entry visible but skip sync/discovery management.

name.description: Human-readable identifier. Also used as the default source directory name.

on_conflict.description: How sync resolves a conflict between the repo copy and local content. Omit for manual resolution (sync errors on conflict).

package.description: Default stow package directory. Defaults to the logical dotfile name.

path.description: Original filesystem location managed by this entry (~ and environment variables are expanded).

DotsGitConfig.description: Controls git behaviour for the dots repository.

auto_commit.description: Run 'git commit' automatically after add/remove operations.

EcosystemSettings.description: Legacy settings for one provider family.

manager.description: Concrete manager used by manager-backed provider families. Omit to auto-detect.

priority.description: Ordered concrete provider/manager priority for this provider family.

check.description: Command that verifies the fallback is installed and usable.

install.description: Install command run by fallback sync/install.

uninstall.description: Optional uninstall command. If absent, uninstall is reported as unavailable.

upgrade.description: Optional upgrade command. If absent, install may be reused for upgrades.

version.description: Optional version command used to display installed fallback version.

asset_pattern.description: Release asset match pattern for this platform.

binary_path.description: Path to the executable inside the downloaded asset for this platform.

checksum.description: Checksum for the matched release asset on this platform.

asset_download_url.description: Resolved release asset download URL recorded at install time.

asset_id.description: Resolved release asset identifier recorded at install time.

asset_name.description: Resolved release asset filename recorded at install time.

asset_pattern.description: Release asset match pattern using fallback template variables.

binary_path.description: Path to the executable inside the downloaded asset, when extraction is needed.

checksum.description: Checksum to verify the matched release asset when confidently known.

checksum_asset_id.description: Release asset the recorded checksum was taken from. A rotated asset re-verifies from the release checksums file.

installed_version.description: Normalized version recorded at install time. Upgrade detection uses it rather than published_at alone.

published_at.description: Publication timestamp of the resolved release, recorded at install time.

release_id.description: Resolved GitHub release identifier recorded at install time.

tag_name.description: Pinned GitHub release tag (e.g. v0.62.2). Omit to use latest.

FallbackSource.description: Where a fallback recipe came from.

owner.description: GitHub repository owner for github sources.

repo.description: GitHub repository name for github sources.

FallbackSpec.description: A best-effort non-provider install recipe for a system tool.

bin_dir.description: Tool-specific binary directory override. Defaults to settings.fallback_bin_dir.

binary.description: Primary executable name installed or checked by this fallback.

platforms.description: Optional OS/architecture-specific release asset overrides keyed by os/arch.

recipe.description: Structured recipe metadata used to generate or edit fallback commands.

release_channel.description: Release channel preference. Empty means stable releases only unless no stable release exists.

source.description: Source metadata for the fallback recipe.

status.description: Resolver or install verification state for this fallback recipe.

GroupConfig.description: A named collection of logical tool memberships and dotfile entries.

dots.description: Dotfile entries managed by this group.

marketplaces.description: Marketplace names assigned to this group.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server names active on this group's hosts.

plugins.description: Plugin names active on this group's hosts.

skills.description: Skill package sources active on this group's hosts.

special.description: Reserved marker for protected host groups.

taps.description: Legacy Homebrew taps for this group. Prefer tool-level 'taps' on logical tool specs.

tools.description: Logical tool names installed by this group.

agents_disabled.description: Master switch: whether the agent skills/mcp/plugins features are disabled on this host.

agents_use.description: Agent identifiers managed on this host. Omit to inherit the global list; an explicit empty list disables all agents here.

auto_import.description: Ignored per host: auto-import is resolved from the global settings scope only.

disabled_providers.description: Provider family names disabled on this host.

dots_disabled.description: Whether dotfile sync is disabled on this host.

dots_repo.description: Host-specific path to the dotfiles git repository.

ecosystems.description: Legacy host-specific provider-family manager and priority overrides.

mcp_disabled.description: Whether the agent mcp feature is disabled on this host.

plugins_disabled.description: Whether the agent plugins feature is disabled on this host.

provider_update_quarantine.description: Per-provider update_quarantine overrides keyed by provider or manager name. Concrete names win over provider families.

providers.description: Bootstrap providers installed before the rest of a sync, in list order.

skills_disabled.description: Whether the agent skills feature is disabled on this host.

update_quarantine.description: Defer updates until the reported availability timestamp is older than this duration.

ManifestSkill.description: Legacy single-skill manifest entry, migrated into agents.packages on load.

agents.description: Target agent IDs for this skill. Empty means all configured agents.

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or commit) to install from.

skill_path.description: Path to the skill directory inside the source.

source.description: Git repository, well-known HTTP catalog, or local directory locator.

Marketplace.description: A plugin marketplace source in the omni agent manifest.

agents.description: Target agent IDs for this marketplace. Empty means all configured agents.

source.description: Marketplace source (owner/repo or URL) as accepted by the agent CLI's marketplace add command.

McpServer.description: One MCP server entry in the omni agent manifest.

agents.description: Target agent IDs for this server. Empty means all configured agents.

command.description: Command to launch the server. Required for stdio transport.

env.description: Environment variable names resolved from the calling environment at restore time.

env_literal.description: Non-secret inline environment values forwarded verbatim.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent to remote http/sse servers. Exact ${VAR} values may be stored as environment-backed headers when supported.

transport.description: MCP transport kind. stdio requires command; http/sse require url.

url.description: Server URL. Required for http/sse transport.

Plugin.description: A plugin installed from either a declared marketplace or a direct source accepted by the agent CLI.

agents.description: Target agent IDs for this plugin. Empty means all configured agents.

marketplace.description: Name of the declared agents.marketplaces entry this plugin comes from.

source.description: Direct plugin source accepted by the target agent CLI, such as owner/repo or a Git URL.

ProviderEntry.description: A provider installed during bootstrap, before the rest of a sync.

hosts.description: Strict hostname-specific install overrides keyed by full or short hostname.

install_with.description: Legacy concrete provider or manager pin accepted for migration.

package.description: Package identifier passed to the provider. Defaults to the entry name.

provider.description: Concrete provider or manager used to install it.

variants.description: Alternate install candidates tried in config order when the default provider is unavailable.

agents_disabled.description: Master switch: disable the agent skills/mcp/plugins features for this settings scope.

agents_use.description: Agent identifiers omni manages. Omit to manage every detected agent.

auto_import.description: Add newly discovered installed tools to the config on every sync.

disabled_providers.description: Provider family names disabled for this settings scope.

dots_disabled.description: Disable dotfile sync for this settings scope.

dots_repo.description: Per-machine path to the dotfiles git repository (~ is expanded).

ecosystems.description: Legacy provider-family settings for system, node, and python. New config should prefer provider_priority and tool providers[].

fallback_bin_dir.description: Default directory for fallback-installed binaries. Omni warns when this directory is not on PATH.

mcp_disabled.description: Disable the agent mcp feature for this settings scope.

plugins_disabled.description: Disable the agent plugins feature for this settings scope.

provider_priority.description: Ordered concrete provider/manager priority applied when a tool does not pin one.

provider_update_quarantine.description: Per-provider update_quarantine overrides keyed by provider or manager name. Concrete names win over provider families.

providers.description: Bootstrap providers installed before the rest of a sync, in list order.

skills_disabled.description: Disable the agent skills feature for this settings scope.

update_quarantine.description: Defer updates until the reported availability timestamp is older than this duration.

SkillPackage.description: A source of one or more agent skills.

agents.description: Target agent IDs for this package. Empty means all configured agents.

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or commit) to install from. Defaults to the package's default branch.

skills.description: Skill names selected from this source. Omitted means every discovered skill.

source.description: Git repository, well-known HTTP catalog, or local directory locator.

ToolInstallSpec.description: One install candidate for a logical tool.

bin.description: Executable name this candidate installs, when it differs from the logical tool name.

bin_dir.description: Optional binary directory override for recipe-backed script installs.

install_with.description: Legacy concrete provider or manager pin accepted for migration. New providers[] entries should put the concrete value in provider.

package.description: Package identifier passed to the provider. Defaults to the logical tool name.

provider.description: Concrete provider or manager for this install candidate.

recipe.description: Optional structured install recipe materialized into provider options at resolve time.

source.description: Optional structured source metadata for recipe-backed install candidates.

ToolSpec.description: A logical tool spec. Providers define concrete install candidates; legacy provider, variants, and hosts fields are migrated on load.

fallback.description: Global fallback recipe used only when this system tool is unavailable from the target system package manager.

git.description: Upstream git repository URL for this tool. Brew metadata refresh and install-from-search may populate GitHub URLs here for later fallback setup.

hosts.description: Strict hostname-specific install overrides keyed by full or short hostname.

ignore.description: Ignore this logical tool globally. Used for imported libraries/packages that should not be managed.

install_with.description: Legacy concrete provider or manager pin accepted for migration. Use providers[].provider for new config.

package.description: Package identifier passed to the provider. Defaults to the logical tool name.

provider.description: Legacy provider field accepted for migration. Use providers[] for new config.

providers.description: Concrete provider candidates for this logical tool, in priority order.

quarantine.description: Per-tool update_quarantine override. Defers updates until the reported availability timestamp is older than this duration.

taps.description: Homebrew taps required before installing this tool.

variants.description: Alternate install candidates tried in config order when the default provider is unavailable.
